response.sql: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT CASE WHEN p.throws IS NULL OR TRIM(p.throws) = '' THEN NULL ELSE p.throws END AS throwing_hand, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM player_award AS pa JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = pa.player_id GROUP BY CASE WHEN p.throws IS NULL OR TRIM(p.throws) = '' THEN NULL ELSE p.throws END), shares AS (SELECT award_count, award_count * 1.0 / SUM(award_count) OVER () AS share FROM hand_counts), compared AS (SELECT award_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share_across_hands FROM shares) SELECT SUM(award_count) AS total_award_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share_across_hands) AS average_excess_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share_across_hands;
